About us | WEXI, s.r.o. ## About us The establishment of our company dates back to 1997. We provide deliveries of goods: - abrasive material (sandblasting, blasting) - - engineering industry - foundry industry - grinding fillings for ball mills - - cement plants - limekilns - thermal power plants - mines At present, we have built long term relationships with our customers throughout Slovakia, also thanks to the fact that the goods can be taken immediately from our warehouses in Považská Bystrica and Humenné. Long term customers are large companies from the Slovak Republic, Poland, the Czech Republic, Hungary, which annually take several tens of tons of material, as well as companies that take several tens of kg. Our goal is the satisfaction of every customer. If you are interested in sending the current price offer, please fill in the contact form or contact us by phone. Thank you and we look forward to our further cooperation. Yours sincerely, Ing. Silicon carbide | Assortment | WEXI, s.r.o. # WEXI, s.r.o. --- ## Silicon carbide [ « back ] --- Context menu: --- ### Silicon carbide Silicon carbide is – after diamond and boron carbide – the third-hardest mineral in the world. Chemically, silicon carbide is extremely resistant and able to withstand the strongest alkalis and acids. In addition to being used as a blasting medium and abrasive, silicon carbide is also used as an aggregate for the production of non-slip, wear-resistant and conductive floor coatings. We will be happy to help you… Application areas - Additive for epoxy resin floors - Bonded grinding wheels - Concrete additive - Cutting discs - Dry blast abrasive - Fine blasting media - Lapping and loose fine grinding - Mixed Alumina | Assortment | WEXI, s.r.o. ## Mixed Alumina ### Mixed Alumina Mixed alumina is a secondary product that is produced from ceramic grounding wheels and reclaimed alumina dust from the blasting and grinding industry. An inexpensive, iron-free product is produced after extensive processing at our recycling plant in Ballenstedt. Our customers like to use mixed alumina to give glass a satin finish or to process fine castings. Cast stainless steel angular Cr grit | Assortment | WEXI, s.r.o. ## Cast stainless steel angular Cr grit ### Cast stainless steel angular Cr grit – DELTA Due to its exceptionally long service life, cast stainless steel angular Cr grit can be a worthwhile alternative to an iron-free, mineral-based abrasive. The angular grain shape makes it possible to prepare stainless materials for a subsequent surface coating.
